attacks.name: Delta Mind
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If that Pokémon has δ on its card, put 3 damage counters instead.

attacks.name: Delta Draw
attacks.text: Count the number of Pokémon you have in play that has δ on its card. Draw up to that many cards.

rules.text: You may attach this as an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon that already has an Energy card attached to it. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.)

effect: Each player can't have more than 3 Benched Pokémon.
